_key.description: Source gene, readout gene, transcript, screen and construct identifier

log2FC.description: DESeq2 log2 fold-change of ORF abundance in high versus low readout-gene FACS bins. Positive values indicate enrichment with higher readout-gene expression.

base_mean.description: DESeq2 mean normalized ORF counts across samples.

p_value.description: Unadjusted DESeq2 p-value for the ORF to readout-gene association.

significant.description: Whether the adjusted p-value is below 0.05.

morf_id.description: ORF construct identifier from the MORF library (DESeq2 rowID / ORF table MORF_id).

orf_gene.description: Ensembl gene ID of the overexpressed ORF when provided in the ORF table.

ensembl_transcript_ids.description: Ensembl transcript IDs mapped from the ORF table for this construct.

refseq_transcript_ids.description: RefSeq transcript IDs listed for this ORF construct.

crispr_modality.description: CRISPR modality from the associated files_filesets record. Null for ORF overexpression screens.

enum: gene overexpression effect on gene expression

files_filesets.description: The filesets of the gene to gene edge

biological_context.description: The biological context of the gene to gene edge

biosample_term.description: The biosample term of the gene to gene edge

treatments_term_ids.description: The treatments term ids of the gene to gene edge

enum: Catalog transcript RefSeq accession without version
transcript_mapping_method.description: Whether transcript IDs were supplied or recovered from Catalog transcript RefSeq cross-references, ignoring accession versions.

transcript.description: Overexpressed transcript associated with this gene-to-gene effect.
